_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/copies/test_ability_source_filter.py. t_dynamo is The Peregrine Dynamo's copy ability, plus a second ability of its own so 'another' has something to refuse; t_legend_gainer is a legendary source with an activated ability to copy. The nonlegendary near side is t_gainer in copy_ability.cards.json.
